## Council question

Does Guild Retreat resolve before or after Break Conditioning?

## Why this needs a ruling

The v0.8 combat table puts Retreat at 4.2 and Break Conditioning at 4.3. The live Guild sheet puts Retreat at 4.3 and prohibits retreat after Break Conditioning has resolved the battle.

## Answer needed

Choose the ordering and specify whether a player may wait for the other effect to be declared before deciding. Example: Break Conditioning would succeed, but Guild wants to pay to retreat.

## Provisional drafting approach

Use the live Guild wording as the candidate and confirm the matching numbered sequence before printing it.

This is a research question, not an adopted ruling or a claim that Norbert has answered it. No answer has been supplied yet. Keep the affected rules provisional until Norbert or the council confirms them.

## Sources

[Live Guild](https://dune.zone/factions/spacing-guild); Quickstart v0.8, Combat Steps.

Part of #1831. Record the confirmed answer, its date and a worked example here before closing. Norbert will share this link with the council; this ticket does not send them a message.
title: Dreamrules ruling: Does Guild Retreat resolve before or after Break Conditioning?
